question: Add a context.Context parameter to the Matches method on the labels.Selector interface in k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/labels. Which files across Helm, ArgoCD, external-dns, and ingress-nginx call Matches() and would need updating?

change.description: The Matches method on labels.Selector interface adds a context.Context parameter. All callers must pass a context, and all implementors must accept it in their signature.

breaking_patterns.why_breaks: The Matches method now requires a context.Context as the first parameter. Existing calls without context will fail to compile.
Types implementing labels.Selector must update their Matches method signature to include context.Context as the first parameter.
Helper functions that wrap selector.Matches calls need to accept and pass a context parameter.
